{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_deduped = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_deduped)

print(n_patients)"}
